incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Smart-routing anomaly detected — sudden increase in 'cheapest_variant' selection for production traffic. Quality alerts firing from regression monitors. AlertID=SR-2024-9982
oliver_oncall: I got paged. seeing a spike in complaints and an uptick in similarity/hallucination regressions in the quality-room dashboard.
oliver_oncall: basic check — latency and capacity look OK, qps steady. it's routing to a low-cost quantized variant instead of baseline.
maria_dev: tagging in. which policy triggered? any recent policy changes? @raj_runtime are you seeing policy eval logs?
raj_runtime: looking now. policy engine shows policy_id=policy-cost_v2 scored cheapest_variant at 0.92 for many requests. signal 'estimated_token_cost' spiked low because of a calc bug in the price oracle. (investigating why).
oliver_oncall: customer-facing tickets on Slack/Support show increased hallucination rates for BigBankTracker, three customers flagged in last 10m. Anne, can you triage customer impact?
anne_cs: on it, pinged affected account owners, opened support tickets. initial guidance: we've switched routing to safer model; customers report improved outputs after a minute.
raj_runtime: mitigation idea — temporarily disable cost-based routing scoring or add a floor so cheapest_variant doesn't go below quality threshold. Can push a quick override to route to redwood-base-v1.
oliver_oncall: do it. paste the CLI you want me to run.
raj_runtime: run: 
```
rictl policy override --id policy-cost_v2 --set route_variant=redwood-base-v1 --reason "emergency mitigation: mis-evaluated cost signal"
```
this will pin traffic for that policy scope.
maria_dev: I'll prepare a follow-up to roll a hotfix to the price-oracle calc. but first we need immediate stopgap.
oliver_oncall: running override now...
oliver_oncall: `rictl policy override ...` executed — response: success, override_id=OVR-4312. routing table updated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: routing override applied by oliver_oncall (OVR-4312). Notifying all regional routers.
anne_cs: customers confirming improvement, one says outputs back to expected. sending update to affected accounts.
leo_product: did we have any canary or canary-safety checks that should've caught this before full rollout?
raj_runtime: canary exists but the cost signal is used in offline scoring and didn't block promotion because the candidate passed perf checks. the quality regression monitors (eval sets) caught it fast — which is good.
maria_dev: I'm pushing small patch to price-oracle: fix division by zero when spot_price missing. test in staging and will deploy to prod in 20m.
oliver_oncall: runbook step followed: page on-call, apply override, notify customers, open postmortem. I'm handing off to maria for remediation and root-cause work. Handoff in 15m.
maria_dev: taking ownership. created incident doc: https://redwood-internal/ops/incidents/1765432100 (will update). Postmortem owner: maria_dev.
sre-bot: :information_source: New alert subscription created: watch-policy-cost_v2 for next 2 hours.
raj_runtime: watching logs — the price oracle pulled from region eu-west-1 had stale cache entries; the aggregator returned 0 for a subset of instances leading to artificially low scores. prepping a fix and a cache invalidation job.
leo_product: please add a short note to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded quality for some customers resolved; routing override in place; root-cause investigation ongoing."
anne_cs: status updated, customers notified. closing immediate CS escalations but keeping hotline open.
maria_dev: deploying price-oracle fix to prod now (rolling, low blast). command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/price-oracle` and then `jobs/invalidate-price-cache --region eu-west-1`
maria_dev: patch deployed and cache invalidation job completed.
raj_runtime: re-evaluating policy scores — cheapest_variant selection dropping back to expected distribution. quality regressions trending back to baseline within 5-10m.
oliver_oncall: great. leaving override in place for 30m to be safe, then we'll lift once signals stable. schedule postmortem meeting at 16:00 UTC.
maria_dev: postmortem outline: timeline, why cost signal could be 0, lack of hard floor in routing policy, missing canary gating for signal anomalies. mitigations: add sanity checks (min price), expand evals to include cost-signal integrity, add alert for price-oracle zero values.
anne_cs: I'll include customer impact summary and ticket references in the postmortem.
leo_product: recommend adding an automatic temporary quality-floor in the router: if predicted quality delta > X, disallow cheapest selection. will add as action item.
oliver_oncall: handoff complete, I'm going offline now. thanks all.
incident-bot: Incident SR-2024-9982 -> status: mitigated. timeline: detection->override->fix->monitoring. Postmortem assigned: maria_dev.
maria_dev: marking resolved for now; will keep watch and re-open if regressions reappear.
